title: Rs 24,600 crore IPO dhamaka: NSE, Hero Motors to lead 11 public offers next week
text: Rs 24,600 crore IPO dhamaka: NSE, Hero Motors to lead 11 public offers next week. NSE will be the biggest issue of the week, with an IPO size of Rs 22,562 crore. Hero Motors will follow with a Rs 1,000 crore issue. The two IPOs will dominate investor attention, while the remaining mainboard and SME issues will compete for retail and HNI money during the same period.
